description: Kalshi and Polymarket weather markets (high, low, rain) in a place: settlement station and rule, the value so far under that rule, forecast daily max/min (or rain) at the station, our value and the official result once settled. No prices: read them from the venue (each row's event and event_url). Needs place, family or venue. line ≈526 tok, table ≈1,757; every city ≈36,291. With none: the list of market cities. A successful result also carries structuredContent: the format=json body (outputSchema).

date.description: today | tomorrow | yesterday | YYYY-MM-DD, each place's local date (default today)

family.description: high | low | rain | all (default all); alone: every market city

fields.description: full (default) | compact: leave out null members of the JSON (structuredContent and format=json)

place.description: Slug, name, 'City, ST' or ICAO; an array for up to 10 places

venue.description: kalshi | polymarket (default both); alone: every market of that venue

name: markets

build.description: The running commit, 7 hex (dev off Tokay). With method, ties this body's numbers to the code and rules that made them (CONTRACTS §51).

credits.description: Credit strings to keep when you repeat numbers.

date.description: today | tomorrow | yesterday | YYYY-MM-DD, each place's local date. Default today: the market's own day at any hour (no 15:00 roll to tomorrow as /blend has); ask tomorrow for the next day's markets.

method.description: Method id: the contract rules that made this body's numbers (blend-median-v1, rain-month-v5, markets-nbm-led-v4, receipts-qa-v1, history-as-issued-v3, status-readiness-v1). A rule change gives a new id, so equal ids mean the same method (CONTRACTS §51).

notes.description: Sentences about this answer; always ends with "No prices.".

places.description: The places answered (the index: every market city with a row).

slug.description: Place slug (a lat,lon for a point).

rows.description: One row per venue x family x kind.

agree.description: Ours vs the venue's result for this event.

agree_30d.description: m/n matches over 30 days once the product passes the claim gate; else null. Pools both venues and every city of the row's product and rule version; agree_30d_detail is the row's own venue, with dates.

checked.description: Events checked (match or differs) for this venue, product and rule version, every city.

last_date.description: The newest checked event date (YYYY-MM-DD, monthly YYYY-MM): a Kalshi count stops at 10/29 (no Kalshi request since, CONTRACTS §33).

match.description: Matches; null until the product has the claim minimum of checked events.

scope.description: What the count pools: every city of the row's venue, product and rule version, not this city alone.

agree_30d_detail.description: agree_30d split by venue, with its dates; null while nothing is checked.

at.description: UTC time of the report that set so_far (ISO).

bound.description: What the result can still be given so far: >=61, <=44, >=1.42.

date.description: The venue's date for this market: YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM (monthly) or YYYY.

derived.description: 1 when the rule names a source we do not fetch and we compute the same number from the open source it shows.

event.description: Venue event id (Kalshi event ticker, Polymarket event slug).

event_url.description: The event page (Kalshi: the series page).

fc.description: Forecast at the settlement station: daily max/min (fc_kind daily_extreme), or the chance in % (pop). The headline, the number to use (CONTRACTS §29; fc_by says where it comes from, method names the rule); the shadow fields are candidates, not the headline.

fc_alt.description: Shadow. (fc_window, else fc) + fc_bias: a candidate forecast, not yet the served fc; null when neither applies. Archived as served and scored against settle values (CONTRACTS §56, §58).

fc_bias.description: Shadow. The correction added for fc_alt: minus the station's median error at this lead (1-3 days) and season, from the settled history, shrunk toward all stations; null without enough cases.

fc_by.description: Where fc comes from: nbm = the station's NBM (NOAA National Blend of Models; Kalshi CLI days after today), blend = the median.

fc_issued_at.description: high/low: the oldest run in fc_runs (UTC): the age of the oldest input behind fc. Null for rain and without a forecast (CONTRACTS §51).

fc_left_h.description: Rain: hours left in the climate day (rain.enabled); else null.

fc_raw.description: Temperature rows: fc as served (shadow fields below leave it unchanged); null on rain rows.

fc_rest.description: Monthly rain: expected rest of month (mean).

fc_rest_p_ge.description: Monthly rain (rain.enabled): {line: chance %} for each strike line of the event's bins (bin lower edges, in unit): the chance the month total reaches the line as the venue counts it (a rain ladder's 'Above X': more than X): the venue's count, moved by the station's hourly rain to each ensemble's start, + its rest (members, then the station's 1991-2020 history). Null when the bins, the distribution or that hourly rain are unknown, and while markets.publish_probs is off (CONTRACTS §58).

fc_rest_thru.description: Non-US: the rest-of-month forecast stops at this date.

fc_runs.description: Runs behind fc. high/low: each input's run or issue time (UTC ISO), aligned with fc_src. Rain: the run hour per family (HHZ, rain.enabled). Null without a forecast.

fc_src.description: Inputs behind fc. high/low: the source ids (/api/v1/sources) whose values made fc, one per input (fc_n of them for a day's median; ["nbm"] when fc_by is nbm). Rain: model families (rain.enabled). Null without a forecast (CONTRACTS §51).

fc_window.description: Shadow. Kalshi days after today with fc_by nbm: the NBM day on the market's midnight-to-midnight standard-time day (NBM's own windows are 19-08 for the low and 07-19 for the high), checked with that NBM cycle's 3-hourly temperatures; equals fc when the added hours do not change it; null when not checked.

final_cli.description: Kalshi CLI rows whose window is over (settling, settled): true once ours is the first final NWS CLI, false before; null otherwise.

flag.description: low_after_midnight: the low may come after midnight (Kalshi day to 1 am); provisional (rain): pop is 100 from rain recorded in METARs or a preliminary CLI, not the final report.

market.description: Kalshi: the market ticker of this city's market in a multi-city series (KXRAINWKND-26NOV14-CHI, KXRAIN-26NOV11-CHI), which `event` serves without the city code: the id Kalshi's own feeds use for this row. Null for a ladder event (one market per bin or line: join on event and the strike), for Polymarket (market ids not ingested: join on the event slug and the bin label) and without an event (CONTRACTS §60).

note.description: State text (rule changed, late), else null.

ours.description: Our reconstructed settle value once the window is done.

partial.description: 1 when an hour of the window has no routine report.

pop.description: Rain markets: chance of 0.01 in or more, %.

product.description: Settlement product (CLI_T, METAR_R, HKO_T, CLI_P, ...; /llms-full.txt has the glossary).

result.description: The venue's official result as text in the market unit (61, 60-61, Yes).

result_src.description: Where `result` comes from, or why there is none.

result_tracked.description: True when groundhog reads this venue's results now; false for Kalshi (no Kalshi request, CONTRACTS §33): result stays null after 10/29.

rule.description: Our one-line paraphrase of the rule (never venue text).

series_key.description: groundhog's series key: the Kalshi series ticker, with the city's market code for a multi-city series (KXRAINWKND-CHI), or the Polymarket slug pattern; the key /api/v1/markets/coverage lists (CONTRACTS §60).

so_far.description: The value so far under the venue's own rule (temperature, or rain total).

src_url.description: The settlement product we read (NWS CLI product, AWC METAR API URL, ...).

state.description: Where the market stands; upcoming = its measuring window has not started (it may be trading: trading_open).

stn.description: Settlement station (ICAO or the source's station id).

trading_open.description: Polymarket: true while the venue lists this event as open for trading (gamma: not closed), false once closed, proposed or settled; null without an event or while groundhog's Polymarket list is stale. Kalshi: null (no Kalshi request, CONTRACTS §33). Independent of state: a day-ahead market trades while its window is upcoming.

unit.description: Unit of every value in this row (the venue's own).

url.description: The market page (Kalshi series page, Polymarket event page).

win.description: Rain: the window of fc (rain.enabled); else null.

win_start.description: Window start (UTC ISO); null for link-only rows.

window_starts_in_h.description: Hours until the measuring window starts (0.1 h); null once it has started or without a window. state upcoming = this is ahead.

url.description: The page that shows this answer (the place page, else /markets).

anyOf.description: markets() with none of place, family and venue: every market city.

outputSchema.description: The JSON body (/api/v1/schema.json); fields=compact drops null members.

title: Weather markets
